column2: >Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

>We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
>We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

>Enterprises hand Cohere their most sensitive data and put our models inside workflows they can\'t afford to get wrong. Securing that means working on problems the industry hasn\'t settled yet, what authorization means when an agent acts on a user\'s behalf, how to contain tools that consume untrusted input, and whether tenant boundaries hold when a model can be steered by the data it reads. The established playbooks only take you so far.

>We\'re hiring a Senior Product Security Engineer to work these problems alongside the engineers building the products, reviewing architecture and code, threat modeling before implementation, testing what ships, and turning what you learn into defaults other teams inherit. This is a hands-on engineering role, not an advisory one.
>Lead security reviews. Review architecture, code, and security-sensitive changes. Identify both individual vulnerabilities and the recurring design patterns behind them.
>Secure AI-powered products. Evaluate risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, identity and delegation failures, excessive agency, data exposure, tenant isolation, and sandbox escapes.
>Threat model new capabilities. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and high-impact failure modes before implementation. Translate findings into practical, prioritized mitigations.
>Perform hands-on testing. Investigate suspected vulnerabilities, develop proofs of concept, assess exploitability and impact, and partner with engineers through remediation.
>Build scalable guardrails. Develop secure defaults, approved patterns, reusable controls, review requirements, and automated checks that reduce recurring risks.
>Strengthen engineering capability. Pair with engineers, document practical guidance, and help product teams develop durable security expertise.
>Influence risk decisions. Explain technical findings, business impact, and remediation options clearly to engineers, product leaders, and executives.

>You understand common vulnerability classes and their underlying design failures, including injection, authorization flaws, IDOR, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, race conditions, cryptographic misuse, and software supply-chain risks.
>You understand modern application architecture, including web applications, APIs, OAuth/OIDC, cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD systems.
>You can reason rigorously about untrusted input, authorization, isolation, identity, delegation, and data boundaries. Direct experience with agentic AI systems is valuable but not required.
>You have driven security improvements involving multiple engineering teams, including situations where influence mattered more than authority.
>You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
>Experience building or operating security tooling such as SAST, DAST, SCA, custom linters, or policy-as-code.
>Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS, enterprise software, or systems that process sensitive customer data.
>Offensive security experience through penetration testing, red teaming or security research.
>Experience operating or participating in a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty program.
>Contributions to open-source security projects, published research, conference talks, or credited vulnerability discoveries.

As Enterprise Fraud Management (EFM) continues to evolve its typology-based approach to First Party Fraud, this leader will play a critical role in building and enhancing a framework that distinguishes fraud from traditional credit risk, enabling more effective controls, stronger detection capabilities, and improved fraud loss management. Operating at an enterprise level, the Senior Manager will influence fraud analytical strategies, drive innovation, and serve as a trusted advisor on emerging fraud trends, analytics best practices, and the application of data-driven insights to protect the bank and its customers.

column1: Reporting to the Director, Analytics and BI - Deposits & Investments within Canadian Banking, the Sr. Manager, Analytics and BI – Investments provides strategic analytical, modelling, and business intelligence support across the Canadian Investments business, including mutual funds and registered and non-registered plan products. The role delivers fact-based recommendations and strategic insights that support profitable customer growth, engagement, margin optimization, channel effectiveness, and stronger decision-making through modelling, forecasting, segmentation, and performance measurement. The incumbent requires strong financial and business acumen, a demonstrated passion for financial services, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners while building collaborative, results-driven teams.

The incumbent will identify opportunities and recommend solutions that strengthen customer growth, engagement, profitability, pricing effectiveness, and overall business performance. The role will also support executive and external stakeholder materials, including analyst presentations, quarterly analyst call preparation, and board strategy materials.
Is this role right for you? - In this role you will:

The Sr. Manager, Analytics and BI – Investments will work closely with the Investments business and key partner teams to develop business cases, campaign measurement, portfolio analytics, standardized reporting, and BI solutions. This role requires a dynamic and engaging leader who can provide strategic insight and actionable recommendations on both regular and ad-hoc requests while sustaining a motivated, high-performing, and team-oriented work environment.

• Provide strategic analytics and business intelligence support to the Retail Investments team by helping business partners grow the customer base, optimize product mix, improve customer primacy, and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, balance growth, cross-sell, up-sell, product activation, usage, and client-level pricing.

• Partner with Investments, Marketing, Campaign Design, Customer Decisioning, Product, Pricing Optimization, Finance, Treasury, Advanced Analytics, and channel teams to shape initiatives, develop segmentation strategies, size opportunities, build business cases, and recommend actions that balance customer experience, revenue growth, budget efficiency, margin optimization, and overall P&L impact.

• Provide strategic support for campaign initiatives by evaluating new ideas, developing pro-forma assumptions, supporting go/no-go recommendations, measuring performance against plan, and applying learnings to improve future targeting, engagement, acquisition, and retention strategies.

• Lead portfolio, pricing, targeting, and performance analytics using advanced analytical methods to identify trends, key statistics, risks, opportunities, and profit drivers across the Investment portfolio.

• Lead the development, validation, interpretation, and application of analytical models, including customer segmentation, propensity, forecasting, profitability, balance growth, pricing sensitivity, campaign response, and scenario models, to quantify opportunities, evaluate trade-offs, and support strategic investment business decisions.

• Lead the standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and performance measurement frameworks, using Power BI and other BI tools to improve consistency, scalability, self-serve access, and senior management decision-making.

• Communicate strategic and operational results clearly and in a timely manner, translating complex analytical findings into recommendations, outlooks, projections, and senior-management-ready insights.
• Manage and prioritize multiple business initiatives, projects, ad-hoc analyses, and stakeholder requests while building trusted relationships with internal partners and external consultants.

• Proactively acquire and apply knowledge of business and product strategies, competitive practices, market insights, policies, technical processes, emerging tools, and analytical methodologies to recommend practical solutions and improve team effectiveness.
• Drive adoption of modern analytics platforms, cloud capabilities, reporting migration, and process improvements to enhance efficiency, reporting quality, scalability, and speed of delivery.

• Lead practical AI adoption across analytics and BI processes to improve the speed, quality, consistency, and scalability of insight generation while promoting responsible use, knowledge sharing, and measurable business impact.
• Champion a customer-focused culture that deepens client relationships and leverages broader Bank relationships, systems, and knowledge.
• Understand and apply the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture in day-to-day activities and decisions.

column1: Owns the strategy, design and delivery of the Scene+ engagement program for Scotiabank clients — using loyalty as a commercial lever to drive profitable client behaviours (primacy, spend, deposit and balance growth, product adoption, digital adoption and retention) rather than as a promotional add-on.

The role defines what “good engagement” looks like at a client level, builds the behaviour-change roadmap that gets clients there, and monetizes Scotiabank’s position in the Scene+ ecosystem by working with coalition partners (Empire/Sobeys, Cineplex, Home Hardware, Shell and emerging partners) to put relevant, high-value earn and redemption experiences in front of Scotiabank clients.

Accountable for the commercial return on loyalty investment — balancing client value, partner value and Bank economics (cost of rewards, points liability, incremental revenue and margin) — while ensuring all activity is executed in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures.
Is this role right for you? - In this role you will:
1. Loyalty Engagement Strategy & Profitable Behaviour Change

column2:
>

  • Build and own a multi-year Scene+ engagement strategy for the Scotiabank client base, with an explicit line of sight from loyalty mechanics to profitable client behaviours and P&L impact.

>

  • Define the target behaviour hierarchy (e.g., card activation and first transaction, everyday spend capture, direct deposit and pre-authorized payments, multi-product depth, digital self-serve adoption, retention at renewal) and the loyalty levers best suited to shift each one.

>

  • Design the earn, bonus, accelerator, tiering, gamification and redemption mechanics that drive those behaviours — including the economics, eligibility rules and guardrails for each.

>

  • Segment the base and set differentiated engagement strategies for new, dormant, single-product, high-potential and at-risk clients.

>

  • Own the loyalty engagement roadmap end to end: opportunity sizing, business case, prioritization, build, launch and post-launch optimization.

>

  • Accountable for the ROI of loyalty engagement investment — incremental revenue and margin delivered per dollar of rewards and marketing spend.

>

  • Model and manage offer economics in partnership with Finance and Data & Analytics: cost per incremental behaviour, breakage and liability assumptions, earn-to-burn ratios, and payback period.

>

  • Set and report the engagement KPI framework (active member rate, earn frequency, redemption rate, points-per-active-member, primacy index, spend lift, attrition delta) and defend results to senior leadership.

>

  • Build a disciplined test-and-learn agenda — control-group design, incrementality measurement, and a documented library of what works, at what cost, for which segments.

>

  • Serve as Scotiabank’s day-to-day engagement lead into the Scene+ coalition and its partners — translating Bank objectives into joint activation plans that also deliver partner value.

>

  • Secure partner-funded and partner-enabled offers, accelerators and experiences that make Scene+ demonstrably more valuable to Scotiabank clients than competitor programs.

>

  • Own and deliver Scotiabank’s contribution to consortium commitments, including the Empire Net New Shopper Commitment, and convert partner audiences into engaged Scotiabank clients.

>

  • Influence the joint marketing calendar, offer inventory and redemption experience to ensure Scotiabank moments are prioritized and sequenced against Bank growth objectives.

>

  • Track partner performance against commitments, surface gaps early, and lead the commercial conversation to close them.

column1: 4. Campaign Design, Personalization & Business Line Enablement

column2: >Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

>We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
>We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

>The GPU Clusters team builds and operates the superclusters that train Cohere’s frontier models. We sit at the intersection of hardware, distributed systems, and AI research. We work with cloud providers, researchers, and other infrastructure teams on problems few companies get to take on.

>As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a team of engineers who care deeply about GPU infrastructure. You’ll set technical direction, grow people, and help the company scale a rapidly growing compute footprint.
>Hire, mentor, and grow a team of GPU infrastructure engineers, including performance, career development, and technical guidance on hard infrastructure problems
>Own the technical roadmap for the fleet: how we deploy, operate, and scale Kubernetes clusters, including workload scheduling, hardware fault detection, and performance
>Partner with researchers and ML engineers so the training and inference stack works well on new GPU architectures
>Work with cross-functional stakeholders such as Capacity, Finance, Legal, Security, and other infrastructure teams on planning, cost, compliance, and shared dependencies
>Drive operational excellence: observability for GPU utilization and reliability, automation of cluster provisioning, cost optimization, and vendor relationships
>You may be a good fit if you have:
>Experience managing engineering or SRE teams, with a focus on technical mentorship, hiring, and growth, including in remote, distributed settings

>A background running large Kubernetes compute fleets in production, including in multi-cloud environments: multi-cluster operations, scheduling, node health at scale, and familiarity with IaC and infrastructure monitoring
>You’ve gone deep in one of the layers that make a GPU training fleet work, whether that’s cluster-wide operations, GPU networking, or hardware, and you’re willing to get hands-on and learn the rest
>Experience with cost optimization and capacity planning for GPU infrastructure
>A track record of partnering with researchers or ML engineers, and of making data-informed tradeoffs across reliability, cost, and delivery

>Contributes to analytics-driven mortgage sampling by reviewing data outputs and identifying trends, patterns, outliers, and key risk indicators across branch, broker, and HFA channels.

>Identifies, analyzes, and communicates risk themes arising from file reviews, quality assurance observations, and analytics-led sampling to support consistent investigative standards, control enhancements, and coordinated responses with RESL, Corporate Security, AML, and other partners.

>Actively pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Are you a curious and open-minded individual with an interest in conducting state-of-theart foundational machine learning research? Thomson Reuters Labs is seeking Research Scientists with a passion for building complex AI systems in a data-rich, complex academic environment driven by real-world problems.

Foundational Research is the dedicated core Machine Learning research division of Thomson Reuters. We are focused on research and development, with a particular focus on advanced algorithms and training techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs). We are building a strong foundation of research capabilities across different areas and are looking for managers who can inspire and guide their teams, are willing to roll up their sleeves and participate in designing, coding, conducting experiments, and translating findings into concrete deliverables. Our focus areas are:
• LLM Training (Continued Pretraining, Instruction Tuning, Reinforcement Learning Alignment, Distributed Training, Efficient ML techniques)
• Data-centric Machine Learning (Synthetic Data, Curriculum Learning, Learned datamixtures, etc.)
• Post-training techniques for planning, reasoning & complex workflows (e.g., Reasoning Models, LLMs + Knowledge Graphs, Test time compute, CoT pipelines, Tool use & API calling, etc.)
• Evaluation (Benchmarks, Human-in-the-loop, red teaming/Adversarial Testing, Hallucination detection, ...)

We work collaboratively both with TR Labs (TR’s applied research division), academic partners at world-leading research institutions and subject matter experts with decades of experience. We experiment, prototype, test, and deliver ideas in the pursuit of smarter and more valuable models trained on an unprecedented wealth of data and powered by stateof-the-art technical infrastructure. Through our unique institutional experience, we have access to an unprecedented number of subject matter experts involved in data collection, testing and evaluation of trained models.

As a Research Scientist Manager, you will play a key part in leading a diverse global team of experts. We hire world-leading specialists in ML/NLP/GenAI, as well as Engineering, to drive the company’s leading internal AI model development. column1: Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Kickstart your career with Scotiabank’s Commercial Aspire Program! This is your opportunity to gain real-world experience, build your network, and explore what it’s like to work in Canadian Commercial Banking—all while contributing meaningfully to our teams. Aspire is designed for ambitious students who are curious, collaborative, and eager to learn. We're looking for students who demonstrate strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity, accountability, and a desire to make a meaningful contribution.

If you’re interested in agriculture and agribusiness, this opportunity will provide hands-on exposure to a team that supports Canadian farms, producers, processors, and agribusinesses. You’ll strengthen your credit, financial analysis, and business acumen while gaining experience understanding clients’ operations, assessing risk, and supporting financing decisions across a diverse and evolving industry.

Agriculture Banking has supported Canadian farms and agribusinesses for more than 180 years, adapting alongside the industry and our clients. From family farms to large-scale producers and processors, our team provides specialized financial advice and solutions to help clients manage their operations, pursue opportunities, and navigate change. One thing remains constant: our commitment to serving those who feed our nation.
With Aspire, you’ll gain early exposure to Agriculture Banking by working on meaningful assignments and learning from experienced professionals. You’ll have opportunities to:

column1: This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Senior Principal DSX Data Scientist in the Data Science Acceleration (DSX) team is responsible for developing scalable tools, environments, and workflows that enable efficient, high-quality statistical computing across Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). This role focuses on creating and maintaining next-generation capabilities that support automation of programming workflows, generation of reusable coding macros, and advanced data visualization. Working closely with statistical programmers, biostatisticians, and clinical scientists, the Data Scientist translates scientific and operational needs into robust, modular, and user-friendly solutions that streamline evidence generation and support faster, more reliable decision-making across the development pipeline.

• You provide strategic and technical leadership in the design and evolution of Roche’s next-generation statistical computing platforms, ensuring they meet the future needs of PDD and the broader organization
• You anticipate emerging industry trends, technologies, and regulatory shifts, and translate them into forward-looking data science capabilities, frameworks, and standards
• You lead large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that redefine how clinical, operational, or real-world data are processed, visualized, and interpreted for decision-making

• You serve as a senior technical advisor to platform owners, programming and statistical leadership, and governance teams on complex topics involving infrastructure, automation, and scientific computing
• You guide technical vision, architectural decisions, and resource planning for high-impact tooling and infrastructure projects across DSX
• You resolve complex, system-level challenges across disciplines by applying deep scientific computing expertise and systems thinking
• You influence internal policy and development standards, and drive adoption of best practices that scale across teams, functions, and geographies
• You communicate complex technical ideas clearly to senior-level stakeholders and shape decisions on investment, tooling strategy, and portfolio priorities
• You foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and innovation through mentorship, internal community building, and knowledge sharing
• You hold a PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in data science, statistical computing, or platform development, with a demonstrated track record of impact at organizational or cross-functional levels
• You are a recognized expert in building and scaling scientific or statistical software systems, with deep understanding of clinical research environments and regulatory implications
• You bring expertise in multiple programming environments (e.g., Python, R) and development practices for reproducible, compliant, and high-performance computing
• You have demonstrated leadership of major programs or cross-functional initiatives with technical complexity and strategic significance
• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain technical strategy with clarity and confidence
• You have proven experience leading global, cross-functional projects or workstreams, demonstrating effective coordination across time zones and diverse stakeholder groups
• Experience shaping the architecture and long-term roadmap of enterprise-scale data science platforms or statistical computing environments
• Demonstrated ability to influence regulatory and quality frameworks in the context of digital and analytical tools
• Strategic understanding of healthcare data ecosystems, including real-world data, translational pipelines, and high-dimensional data integration
• Proven ability to drive tool adoption and cultural change through technical leadership, stakeholder engagement, and thoughtful design
• Engagement with external scientific or developer communities (e.g., open-source contributions, industry consortia, conference presentations)
• Experience guiding investment and resource decisions for high-impact tooling or analytics initiatives
• Ability to synthesize organizational priorities and translate them into impactful, technically sound solutions at scale
Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

JOB DESCRIPTION

Our global Reuters News Internship Program gives you the chance to fast-track your journalism career and develop your skills across a variety of subjects and media. We welcome passionate and curious reporters, producers and photojournalists who want to tell stories for a global audience. Reuters seeks diverse candidates from all backgrounds and is excited to work with emerging talent who can cover breaking news and tell in-depth stories from new perspectives.

We are looking for an intern to join our Audience team in the London newsroom. This team uses data and digital tools to understand and engage global audiences with Reuters journalism. Working closely with the newsroom, the Audience team helps optimise content for various platforms and formats—including articles, newsletters, social media, push alerts, video, and podcasts.
Our mission is to grow the reach and impact of Reuters journalism by helping shape stories that resonate with specific audiences.
• A strong understanding of the importance of connecting the public with high-quality, fact-based journalism - especially in an era of disinformation.
• A demonstrable interest in how data can inform editorial decision-making and audience engagement.
• Ambition to deliver journalism with real impact
• An international outlook and ability to work in a team and communicate across departments
• Good working knowledge of writing and reporting in English required
• An assigned Senior Editor as a mentor
• Interns are expected to bring ideas, energy, enthusiasm, and a start-up mentality to a versatile cross-discipline team
• Monitor Reuters TV, picture, and social media output to report on the biggest global stories
• Participants who excel may be considered for future opportunities at Reuters
• Applicants must be eligible to work in the region/country to which they apply
• The deadline for applications is Friday 12th December 2025 at 1700 GMT
• Please apply with an up-to-date CV and answer our application questions

Founded 170 years ago, Reuters provides society with the news it needs to be free, prosperous and informed. Each day, 2,500 journalists in nearly 200 locations around the globe deliver unparalleled international and national news coverage in 16 languages with speed, impartiality and insight. Reuters stays true to the letter and spirit of the Thomson Reuters Trust Principles, valuing independence, integrity and freedom from bias.

Reuters news is read and seen by billions of people worldwide every day. Our stories reach more than 750 broadcasters in 115 countries and 1,000 publishing clients, including eight of the world’s top 10 newspapers.
• 35 million unique monthly visitors to Reuters.com.
• Hundreds of thousands of professionals using Thomson Reuters premium products.

Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Este programa rotativo de 12 meses ofrece una inmersión integral en planificación financiera, asesoría patrimonial y servicios fiduciarios, preparando al asociado para contribuir activamente en entornos reales de asesoría.

El IWMAP representa el primer paso en una trayectoria profesional de largo plazo dentro del equipo Total Wealth, diseñada para formar asesores que construyan una carrera sólida y sostenible en la organización. En este entorno, la colaboración, el enfoque en el cliente y la planificación holística son el centro de todo lo que hacemos, alineados con los valores de excelencia, integridad y visión global de Scotiabank.
Participar en rotaciones estructuradas en áreas clave del negocio:
• Acompañar a profesionales experimentados mediante sesiones de observación para obtener perspectivas interfuncionales.
• Participar en actividades reales de asesoría y atención al cliente.
• Colaborar con coaches y mentores asignados para recibir seguimiento y orientación personalizada.
• Construir una red profesional sólida dentro de Scotia Wealth Management y mercados internacionales.
Participar en iniciativas de aprendizaje continuo que incluyen:
• Promover una cultura centrada en el cliente, fortaleciendo relaciones y aprovechando las capacidades globales del Banco.
• Comprender y aplicar la cultura de gestión de riesgos y cumplimiento regulatorio en las actividades diarias.
• Ejecutar operaciones de manera eficiente y conforme a los controles establecidos para mitigar riesgos operativos, regulatorios, de conducta, lavado de dinero y financiamiento al terrorismo.
• Participación en equipos de Gestión Patrimonial Internacional en distintas ciudades de México.
• Exposición directa a líderes, mentores y profesionales senior de Wealth Management.

The Senior Manager, CCR Analytics leads a team in the design, implementation, and oversight of counterparty credit risk measurement and analytics. The role focuses on delivering robust exposure methodologies (PFE, Settlement, stress), ensuring model usage integrity, and providing actionable insights to trading desks, risk oversight, and senior management.
This role combines advanced quantitative expertise with leadership responsibilities, ensuring that CCR analytics frameworks are accurate, scalable, and aligned with regulatory expectations.
<li>Lead the calculation, validation, and analysis of CCR metrics including:<ul>
• Oversee treatment of complex/non-standard trades and ensure appropriate modeling of exposures
<li>Identify weaknesses in pricing models and exposure methodologies
• Ensure appropriate application of CCR models and methodologies across portfolios
<li>Partner with model development and validation teams on:<ul>
• Provide subject matter expertise on CCR methodologies (netting, collateral, margining, wrong-way risk)
• Provide analytics and insights to trading desks and portfolio managers on counterparty exposures, concentrations, and sensitivities
• Analyze drivers of exposure changes (market moves, trades, collateral) and communicate implications clearly
• Support new initiatives such as new product or feature by analyzing impact to CCR and providing insight into mitigating them
• Deliver high-quality analytics supporting regulatory exams and internal governance reviews
• Ensure integrity and reconciliation of exposure data across systems
• Work closely with infrastructure teams to enhance data pipelines and analytics performance
• Drive automation of CCR analytics processes (data ingestion, calculations, reporting)
• Promote efficient, scalable analytics processes to support growing portfolios
• Market Risk Oversight and Credit Risk teams
• Ensure clear understanding of CCR exposures and methodologies across stakeholders
<li>Lead and mentor a team of CCR <span style=""display:inline
• Provide technical guidance on exposure methodologies and analytics
• Manage delivery timelines for BAU and regulatory commitments
• MSc or equivalent in Quantitative Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related field
• 7–10 years in CCR analytics, market risk, or quantitative risk roles
• Strong experience with exposure metrics (PFE, CVA, EE) and financial products (Derivatives and Security Financing Transactions)
• Experience supporting regulatory deliverables and/or stress testing
• Programming skills (Python/SQL preferred) for analytics and automation
• Familiarity with risk engines (e.g., Adaptiv or similar platforms)
• Familiarity with managing daily operations for risk or trading systems
• Ability to translate complex analytics into business insights
• Effective communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Drives accuracy and robustness of CCR exposure measurement
• Pricing and trading strategies (via exposure and CVA insights)
• Acts as a key bridge between quantitative modeling, risk oversight, and business decision-making

column1: Joining the Consumer and Small Business team means becoming part of the engine that drives Wireless, Internet and TV growth for Bell and Virgin across digital, direct and retail channels. We operate in a modern, agile model spanning Marketing Intelligence, Strategy & Planning, Go-To-Market Execution, National Retail Operations and Channel Enablement. For a new graduate, this means you will not learn one narrow job—you will gain a 360-degree view of how a national telecommunications and media provider turns strategy into consistent execution across corporate stores, dealers and major third-party retail partners. Over a 13-month journey, you will tackle real-world business challenges, collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners, and gain hands-on experience in strategy, analytics, customer journeys, retail operations, process design, written communications and national program execution.

Upon completion of the program, you will have the knowledge, skills, network and breadth of experience needed to become part of the next generation of leaders at Bell. Through three rotations and meaningful business projects, you will build knowledge across Marketing, Product, National Retail Operations and Channel Enablement. You may support priorities such as partner go-to-market planning, store readiness, process improvement, product and offer launches, communications, training materials, performance reporting and post-launch follow-up.

• Broad Business Exposure: You will experience the full lifecycle of a national initiative—from customer and performance insights, product pricing and planning through channel readiness, launch and post-implementation review.

• National Retail Operations: You will gain behind-the-scenes insight into national retail operations, store performance, workforce and operational processes, and the in-store customer and employee experience across multiple retail formats.

• Channel Enablement: You will help translate business priorities into clear, executable processes, communications, job aids, training content and launch plans that equip sales leaders and front-line teams to deliver with consistency.

• Partner Engagement & Influence: You will communicate with external retail partners and internal teams, gather requirements, navigate competing priorities, build alignment and influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.
• Executive Visibility: You will share progress, insights and recommendations with senior leaders, including presenting your capstone recommendations at the end of the program.
• Mentorship & Support: You will be paired with a dedicated peer mentor and receive regular coaching from experienced leaders across the business.
• Bachelor's degree, master’s degree, or college diploma in Business and/or Marketing programs or a related field completed before the program start date.

• You are aligned with working in-person at a Toronto based Bell office location a minimum of 3 days per week. We value in-person collaboration and believe working in-office is the best way to establish meaningful relationships, build your network, and interact with our Leadership Team.
• Experience through academic, volunteer or professional work in marketing, retail, operations, communications, project management or a related field.
• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into concise, audience-appropriate emails, executive updates, process documents, job aids and presentations.

• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, including confidence communicating with external partners, facilitating discussions, managing expectations and building alignment across diverse interests.
• Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, use sound judgement and move cross-functional work forward in a complex, fast-paced environment.

column3: >Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.
>Air Canada is seeking a Manager, Product to lead the Marketing Tools & Experiences stream.

>You will own two things. What customers see: the home page, marketing across our digital channels, campaign pages, deals, and search. And what marketers work in: the tools they use to build pages, manage content, and set up offers.
>This is a player-coach role. You will lead a team of product people and still do product work yourself.

>You will be the product partner to senior leaders in Marketing, Brand, and Revenue. You will turn what they need into a clear roadmap, say no when it matters, and show the value of what the team ships in business terms.

>AI is part of how this stream works. You will own the vision for AI-guided campaign creation and marketer self-serve. The goal is that marketers can plan, build, and launch good work with less hand-off and less waiting.
>Own the product strategy and roadmap for marketing experiences, marketer tools, and marketer platforms.
>Own the home page. Decide what earns space on it, balance marketing, booking, and loyalty needs, and measure how it performs.
>Own the discoverability strategy. Make sure customers find Air Canada\'s routes, deals, and content in search engines and in AI assistants and answer engines.
>Define and drive the marketer self-serve strategy. Reduce the manual steps between an idea and a live campaign.
>Set the vision for AI-guided campaign creation, and turn it into a staged plan with clear proof points.
>Decide what to build, buy, or retire across the marketing stack, together with platform and technology partners.
>Build business cases and present investment recommendations to marketing, revenue, and technology leadership.
>Own the stream\'s results: adoption and time saved for marketer tools, and engagement, conversion, and revenue for customer experiences.
>Track organic performance: search visibility, organic traffic and revenue, and how often AI assistants cite or recommend Air Canada content.
>Set measurable goals for each product area, and report on them on a regular cadence.
>Make sure experimentation, personalization, and optimization are run with sound measurement and clear decision rules.
>Champion standards for quality, consistency, accessibility, consent, and measurement across everything the stream delivers.
>Lead, coach, and develop a team of about eight product managers, technical product managers, and product owners.
>Hire to grow the PM bench. Define what good looks like at each level, and give direct, regular feedback.
>Manage vendor and partner product roles, with clear ownership and accountability.
>Keep ownership clear across product areas, so each part of the portfolio has one accountable owner.
>Remove blockers and protect the team\'s focus.
>Work as a player-coach. Personally own the early, undefined work, such as AI-guided campaign creation, until it is ready to hand to a PM on the team.
>Manage senior relationships across Marketing, Brand, Revenue, Loyalty, and Digital.
>Balance competing requests into one prioritized roadmap, and explain the trade-offs openly.
>Partner with engineering, design, data, and platform teams to move work from discovery to production.
>Coordinate dependencies with adjacent product streams, including booking, loyalty, and the shared design system.
>Bachelor\'s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
>7+ years in product management, marketing technology, or digital experience, with at least 2 years leading product managers or product owners.
>A track record of owning both internal tools and customer-facing digital products, with measurable results in each.
>Experience setting product strategy and a multi-quarter roadmap across several product areas.
>Strong working knowledge of marketing platforms, such as Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Experience Manager, and how content, customer data, personalization, and offers fit together.
>Experience with experimentation and optimization programs, including test design and reading results.
>Working knowledge of SEO, including technical SEO, structured data, and content at scale, plus a point of view on how AI search and answer engines change discoverability (GEO).
>Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows, and the judgment to evaluate them properly before scaling them.
>Still hands-on. Comfortable writing specs, building prototypes, and working in the tools yourself, while leading a team. Candidates will be asked to walk through something they built recently.
>Experience managing senior stakeholders and influencing decisions without direct authority.
>Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product people.
>Clear written and spoken communication, including to executive audiences.
>Experience in airline, travel, loyalty, or large-scale consumer digital platforms.
>Experience managing vendor or partner delivery teams.
>Experience with content operations, DAM, or headless CMS programs.
>Experience with evaluation methods for AI-generated content.
>Experience with design systems and component governance.

column2: >Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

>We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
>We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
>We’re seeking an experienced Product Manager to own the creation of Cohere’s managed offering. This is a high-leverage role helping shape the future of Cohere’s market strategy. This role will:
>Lead the strategy and execution for launching a self-serve version of North that unlocks Cohere\'s capabilities for mid-market companies without complex deployment.
>Shape the strategic vision for bringing enterprise-grade AI to this segment, defining the possibilities while building influence across teams to turn vision into reality.
>Discover the right market rhythm, forge partnerships with GTM teams to drive adoption, and establish a new revenue stream alongside Cohere’s existing offering.
>Influence North\'s deployment framework, creating solutions that eliminate infrastructure barriers while ensuring data residency, compliance, and operational confidence.
>Partner closely with both engineering leadership and GTM functions to bring this offering from concept to market.
>Drive the roadmap and strategy for managed North, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term platform investment.
>Partner with GTM teams to test assumptions, validate market needs, and iterate based on customer feedback, ensuring your solutions deliver real business value through seamless production operations.
>Engage directly with customers and developers to understand integration challenges, validate priorities, and surface unmet needs.
>Define success metrics for platform health and developer experience, and lead initiatives to move them.
>Partner with engineering, research, technical writing, and developer relations to ship and document platform improvements.
>5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent owning a B2B SaaS product.
>A track record of thinking about infrastructure as a product, with the ability to translate system-level capabilities into clearly differentiated, customer-facing features.
>Entrepreneurial and experience taking new products to market.
>Experience with deployment models such as multi-tenant and dedicated infrastructure.
>Analytical by default: you define success metrics before you build, instrument thoughtfully, and use data alongside qualitative feedback to make decisions.
>Strong collaborator who works well across engineering, design, infrastructure, and GTM teams, and who can communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to a range of stakeholders.
>Highly execution-oriented with a bias toward shipping and iterating quickly.
>Demonstrated ownership across the full product lifecycle — from problem definition and scoping through launch, iteration, and eventual deprecation or migration.
>Exposure to data residency, sovereignty, or regional compliance requirements as they apply to AI or cloud infrastructure products.
>Experience owning a model serving or inference platform.

>Familiarity with the AI developer ecosystem and open standards, including orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, model serving frameworks such as vLLM, and an awareness of de facto interoperability standards and how they shape developer adoption and integration patterns.
>Impact: Shape the developer surface of one of the world\'s leading enterprise AI platforms, used by developers and enterprises building production AI systems at scale.
>Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges at the frontier of AI.
>Growth: Enjoy competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development.
>Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in San Francisco, New York, and Toronto.

column5: >Bell's  Site Architecture team is seeking a motivated individual to define the long-term vision and strategy for site architecture with a dedicated focus on power infrastructure and energy management. In this senior technical leadership role, you will drive the technology roadmap for site-level power systems, evaluate and introduce emerging sustainable energy technologies and establish architectural standards aimed at reducing network energy consumption and operational expense. Acting as a key subject matter expert, you will own and collaborate cross-functionally to standardize robust, resilient and highly efficient energy practices, while directly contributing to broader site and architecture standards, designs and technical decisions across the national network.

column7: >National Roadmap & Strategy: Develop, own and execute the long-term national technology strategy roadmap for energy management and power plant infrastructure across the entire radio access network.

>Future Network Scalability: Evaluate emerging site-level power demands driven by wireless network densification  and edge computing, proactively adapting the power architecture to support future scale.
>Design and Cost Efficiency: Define architectural standards, site designs and engineering best practices aimed specifically at reducing operational expenditure (OPEX) across national sites.

>Next-Gen Tech & Renewable Integration: Lead the technical evaluation and network-wide introduction of emerging renewable energy technologies establishing the underlying technical standards and site-level guidelines.

>Hardware, Vendor and Security Compliance: Evaluate traditional power infrastructure hardware (such as rectifiers, DC plants, and battery/generator systems) and manage vendor roadmaps to ensure strict technical, quality and security compliance.<span style=""font-family:Roboto
>AI/ML Energy Optimization: Spearhead advanced AI/ML-driven energy initiatives, focusing on smart capabilities such as predictive maintenance, load forecasting and dynamic power shedding.

>ESG & Carbon Footprint Ownership: Own the technical energy consumption strategies required to meet corporate carbon footprint reduction and Net-Zero targets, ensuring all site installations comply with environmental regulations, safety standards and local electrical codes.

>Market Intelligence & Industry Tracking: Actively track global telecom industry trends, regulatory updates and vendor innovations regarding sustainability and energy efficiency in telecommunications networks.

>Business Cases & Financial Justification: Build comprehensive business cases, total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses and cost-benefit frameworks to financially justify investments in new energy technologies and optimization initiatives.

>Mentorship & Technical Guidance: Act as the principal subject matter expert, providing strong technical direction, architectural guidance and mentorship to engineers and architects on power and energy infrastructure.
>Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Energy Systems, or a related technical field.
>8+ years of engineering experience in telecommunications, utilities or critical infrastructure.
>Deep technical expertise in power grid systems, rectifiers, battery chemistry (VRLA, Li-ion) and backup generator operations.
>Proven capability in building financial business models, cost-benefit analyses and TCO evaluations for capital projects.

>Expertise in regulatory compliance, including a strong working knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), IEEE electrical power standards, and global telecom sustainability and energy efficiency guidelines (e.g., GSMA, ATIS, and ETSI)
>Strong leadership presence with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across multi-functional engineering teams.
>Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline or an active Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
>Familiarity with RF and 5G systems, including the specific power draws associated with modern cellular equipment.
>Experience leading sustainability/ESG metrics tracking or renewable energy integration in a corporate or utility network environment.
>Knowledge of vendor  software configurations, specifically around utilizing software-driven sleep modes and energy-saving features.

column2: >Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

>We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
>We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

>We’re building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you’ll lead the team that makes Cohere’s data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly.

>Your team owns the full data lifecycle. You’ll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces. Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk.

>This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you’ll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable. The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people’s heads.
>As the head of the Data Foundation pillar, you will:
>Build and lead the team. Hire and grow a team of data and infrastructure engineers
column4: develop strong talent and raise team performance, building leadership capability beneath you.

column2: >Set the roadmap from company strategy. Own and sequence the Data Foundation roadmap: the warehouse buildout, the agentic analytics program, data governance, and the platform work that unblocks our other pillars. You’ll make the trade-offs and carry the cross-functional impact that comes with them.

>Own the data platform end to end. Ingestion (managed connectors and an open-source connector framework), orchestration on Airflow and Cloud Run, warehouse modeling in BigQuery with dbt (raw, core, mart layers), and serving through Looker, export APIs, and semantic layers. All of it provisioned as code in Terraform.

>Own data governance. Define how humans, service accounts, and agents get access to governed data: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, documented onboarding paths, audit logs, and sensitive requests (including legal holds) handled to deadline.

>Operate for reliability. Run the alerting and anomaly-detection framework, own data freshness SLAs, lead incident response and postmortems, and turn every incident into a durable standard so the same class of failure doesn’t recur.

>Lead the agentic analytics program. Wire the semantic layer into an internal analytics agent, build the eval harness that measures its accuracy, and make the eval-driven call on where AI earns its way into production. Apply the same discipline to automating data engineering work itself.

>Set the standard for analytics across the company. The medallion framework, naming conventions, and testing patterns your team maintains become the way other teams ship analytics data. You’ll onboard new domains onto it and keep the docs accurate to how the systems actually work.

>Partner across the org. Work with the North product and engineering teams on the analytics surfaces that ship in the product (including a customer-facing analytics export), with Business Insights on marts for the business, with Security on data governance, and with Legal on compliance-critical data requests.
>You may be a good fit, if you have:
>10+ years of experience across data engineering, data infrastructure, or analytics platform work, with a strong management track record leading data platform or infrastructure teams
>Serious hands-on history in data engineering or infrastructure before management. You can still read a Terraform plan, a dbt DAG, or an Airflow scheduler log and ask the question that matters
>Production experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)
>Depth in data modeling: you think in fact and dimension tables, raw/core/mart separation, and semantic layers, and you have opinions on where tests and contracts belong
>A record of setting a team’s roadmap from company or function strategy and delivering outcomes that span teams, with the cross-functional partnerships to match
>Operational excellence you can point to: alerting you trust, SLAs you meet, incidents you run to ground and write up so they teach
>Exposure to data security and governance: IAM, access management, VPC service controls or equivalent, audit and compliance workflows
>Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and are energized by building the data foundation an AI company (and its AI agents) runs on
>Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading a multi-workstream roadmap, and working directly with executives on priorities
>If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

column1: Global Transaction Banking (GTB) is the payments and transaction engine of Scotiabank. We support Small Business, Commercial and Corporate clients with effective treasury management solutions coupled with a best-in-class service model, making it easy for clients to do business with us.

As businesses build their digital capabilities and transform their operating models, their payment needs are evolving too. Boasting a unique global footprint, GTB’s comprehensive suite of innovative banking solutions help our business clients generate operational efficiencies, streamline and simplify payments, improve working capital performance, and mitigate financial risk.

At Scotiabank, we embrace your strengths, ideas, and ambitions. GTB is a fast-growing team with a focus on the Americas, particularly Canada, the U.S., Mexico, and we are seeking top tier talent to complement our organization.
Join a purpose-driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Purpose
The Manager, Business Intelligence & Insights for Global Banking Transaction Banking is responsible for leading the development and end-to-end delivery of business insights by partnering closely with business stakeholders, analytics engineering teams, and technology teams. The incumbent contributes to the overall success of GTB by transforming complex data into meaningful, actionable insights that support strategic decision-making in a timely and scalable manner.

The successful candidate brings strong technical, financial, and analytical expertise, along with the ability to communicate effectively with audiences up to and including Scotiabank executives. This individual is a dynamic and organized self-starter who thrives in environments of ambiguity, is highly detail-oriented, and operates effectively in a fast-paced setting. Strong leadership, business acumen, and an in-depth understanding of GTB products, services, and operations are essential.
• Design visually impactful and intuitive dashboards supported by efficient and scalable data models, leveraging industry best practices and advanced modeling techniques.
• Demonstrate strong problem-solving and data storytelling capabilities through dashboards and visualizations.
• Deliver actionable insights to GTB business stakeholders across Sales, Product, Channels, Operations, Strategy, and Risk.
• Collaborate closely with Salesforce CRM teams to define enhancement requirements and resolve data quality issues.
• Support ad hoc analysis requests to inform and drive strategic business decisions.
• Ensure accuracy, governance, and appropriate access controls across the BI ecosystem.
• Identify, prioritize, analyze, remediate, and escalate data and reporting issues as required.
• Serve as a centre of excellence for GTB business, Product, and Payments analytics, acting as a trusted advisor on all matters related to data and analytics.
• Ideate and develop best-in-class automation solutions and reporting tools to support Sales, Payments, and Product teams in effective portfolio management.
• Partner closely with GTB Analytics Engineering and Advanced Analytics teams to solve complex business challenges.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with GTB business stakeholders across Sales, Product, Operations, Channels, and Strategy.
• Collaborate with GBM Client Insights & Analytics, Commercial Banking Analytics, and Business Banking Analytics teams to ensure alignment and knowledge sharing.
• Incorporate the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture into day-to-day activities and decision-making.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
• Master’s degree or MBA considered an asset.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, insights, or related fields.
• Strong technical expertise in Microsoft Power BI, SQL, and data modeling.
• Solid understanding of ETL processes, data mining, profiling, cleansing, and enrichment.
• Hands-on experience with cloud technologies such as Azure Databricks and Google BigQuery.
• Knowledge of the Canadian banking and payments industries.

>Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with experience using industry-standard simulation and debug tools.

>Strong understanding of cache coherency, transaction ordering, and system-level data flows.
>Experience with performance verification, including bandwidth, latency, QoS, and traffic management.
>Strong scripting skills in Python, Perl, or Shell, along with excellent communication and collaboration skills.

column5: >Bell's  Site Architecture team is seeking a motivated individual to define the long-term vision and strategy for site architecture with a dedicated focus on power infrastructure and energy management. column7: >National Roadmap & Strategy: Develop, own and execute the long-term national technology strategy roadmap for energy management and power plant infrastructure across the entire radio access network.

>Market Intelligence & Industry Tracking: Actively track global telecom industry trends, regulatory updates and vendor innovations regarding sustainability and energy efficiency in telecommunications networks.

>Business Cases & Financial Justification: Build comprehensive business cases, total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses and cost-benefit frameworks to financially justify investments in new energy technologies and optimization initiatives.

>Mentorship & Technical Guidance: Act as the principal subject matter expert, providing strong technical direction, architectural guidance and mentorship to engineers and architects on power and energy infrastructure.
>Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Energy Systems, or a related technical field.
>8+ years of engineering experience in telecommunications, utilities or critical infrastructure.
>Deep technical expertise in power grid systems, rectifiers, battery chemistry (VRLA, Li-ion) and backup generator operations.
>Proven capability in building financial business models, cost-benefit analyses and TCO evaluations for capital projects.

>Expertise in regulatory compliance, including a strong working knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), IEEE electrical power standards, and global telecom sustainability and energy efficiency guidelines (e.g., GSMA, ATIS, and ETSI)
>Strong leadership presence with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across multi-functional engineering teams.
>Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline or an active Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
>Familiarity with RF and 5G systems, including the specific power draws associated with modern cellular equipment.
>Experience leading sustainability/ESG metrics tracking or renewable energy integration in a corporate or utility network environment.

column2: >NVIDIA is seeking a motivated and creative Senior Verification Engineer to join our Tegra SoC IP Verification team. You will help define verification strategies, develop robust verification environments, drive functional and performance verification, close coverage, and ensure high-quality design signoff. This position provides an opportunity to work on technologies at the heart of NVIDIA\'s next-generation computing platforms.
>Develop and maintain verification infrastructure, including testbenches, BFMs, checkers, monitors, scoreboards, assertions, and constrained-random stimulus.
>Define, review, and complete verification test plans for coherency protocol, ordering, error handling, performance, and other key IP features.

>Develop and complete performance test plans to validate bandwidth, latency, QoS, and other performance requirements.
>Drive functional and code coverage closure and toward verification signoff.
>Debug complex RTL and verification issues and work closely with architecture and design teams to drive them to resolution.
>Collaborate with FPGA, emulation, software, and post-silicon teams to support system validation and silicon bring-up.
>3+ years of ASIC verification experience with complex IPs or SoC subsystems.
>Strong background in SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained-random verification, and coverage-driven verification methodologies.
>Experience developing verification environments, checkers, assertions, and functional coverage.
>Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with experience using industry-standard simulation and debug tools.
>Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
>Experience verifying high-speed coherent interconnects, NoCs, or other complex SoC infrastructure IP.
>Knowledge of coherent interconnect protocols and technologies such as CHI and AXI.
>Strong understanding of cache coherency, transaction ordering, and system-level data flows.
>Experience with performance verification, including bandwidth, latency, QoS, and traffic management.
>Strong scripting skills in Python, Perl, or Shell, along with excellent communication and collaboration skills.

As a Consultant, Data Mesh Enablement & EDGE Onboarding, you\'ll support the adoption and day-to-day operation of EDGE as a reusable, governed enterprise data capability. You\'ll coordinate onboarding activities from initial intake through product registration, access enablement, and ongoing use, while working closely with business partners, Product Owners, Data Owners, Data Stewards, Enterprise Architecture, Data Governance, Information Security, platform engineering, and delivery teams. You\'ll also help improve metadata, catalogue, and self-service processes that strengthen discoverability, trust, and reuse across enterprise data assets. In this role, you\'ll contribute to a well-governed and efficient onboarding experience by supporting reporting, workflow improvements, and operational excellence across the EDGE ecosystem.

Onboarding and intake coordination - Conduct intake assessments and exploratory discussions to understand business needs and guide teams through the appropriate onboarding, data access, ingestion, product registration, or enablement pathway. Coordinate activities, dependencies, stakeholder follow-ups, and status updates to support timely onboarding progress.

Governance and product registration - Review data product registration requests for completeness, including business purpose, ownership, lineage, consumers, source awareness, metadata, and supporting documentation. Support the maintenance of enterprise inventory records and help ensure registrations align with data product and federated governance standards.

Metadata and catalogue support - Validate metadata associated with data elements, tables, views, schemas, and registered data products. Support catalogue and dashboard operations through monitoring, reconciliation, issue triage, and process improvements that enhance data quality, discoverability, and trust.

Self-service enablement - Develop and maintain onboarding guides, frequently asked questions, job aids, training materials, process maps, and other self-service resources. Turn recurring questions and support themes into clear documentation, workflow enhancements, and backlog opportunities.

Access and consumer support - Guide teams through access and entitlement requirements and support standard access patterns, group templates, and request-routing processes. Help ensure onboarding and access information is captured in a controlled, traceable, and user-friendly way.

Operational improvement and reporting - Maintain reporting that tracks onboarding activity, product registration, ownership, adoption, and outstanding actions. Identify opportunities to simplify manual work and improve repeatable processes using tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Power Automate, Excel, Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, and application programming interfaces (APIs).

You have relevant experience. You bring experience supporting data onboarding, governance, operations, or enablement activities in a large and complex environment. You’re comfortable coordinating across business and technology teams to move work forward.

You give meaning to data. You enjoy working with metadata, ownership records, lineage, and operational reporting to identify gaps, resolve discrepancies, and improve decision-making. You can interpret detailed information and communicate it clearly to different audiences.

You\'re motivated by collective success. You work well with cross-functional partners and know how to build strong working relationships across governance, architecture, engineering, security, and delivery teams. You collaborate effectively to support shared outcomes.

You know that details matter. You bring strong attention to detail when reviewing registrations, validating information, maintaining records, and supporting controlled operational processes. You can manage multiple activities while maintaining accuracy.

You\'re digitally savvy. You’re comfortable using and improving tools and processes that support workflow automation, reporting, and self-service enablement. Experience with Jira, SharePoint, Power Automate, Excel, SQL, Python, or related tools is an asset.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

column1: Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We\'re driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless.

Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com, saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.
Learn more at www.ada.cx.

The Solutions team designs the integrations and bespoke solutions that extend Ada’s AI Agent to our clients’ business systems. We’re looking for a Senior Solution Architect to be the trusted technical advisor to our clients and deal teams, from pre-sales to long after launch. You\'ll take a holistic view of each client\'s business and technical landscape and shape the right solution, raising their AI Agent\'s automated resolution rate at a company defining how enterprises adopt AI agents for customer service.
As a Senior Solution Architect you will:
• Partner with Solutions Consultants on complex deals beyond out of the box, owning the solution architecture and turning the art of the possible into something deliverable.
• Lead technical deep dives with client business and engineering teams, translating business goals into clear technical requirements and recommending the right approach.

• Own the design of technical solutions that connect Ada’s AI Agent to clients’ business systems and data, such as CRMs, contact centres, commerce platforms, knowledge bases and BI tools, using Ada’s APIs, SDKs and MCP.
• Design and scope bespoke solutions, implement working POCs, then drive them to production with our engineers.
• Serve as the technical advisor to Customer Success on existing and strategic accounts, identifying where technical solutions can improve a client’s AI Agent performance.
• 6+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as solution architect, sales engineer, integration engineer or technical consultant at a SaaS or consulting company.

• Experience designing technical solutions across REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs and event-driven patterns, including auth (OAuth 2.0, JWT), PII handling and design for scale and rate limits, and writing specs engineers deliver against.
• Experience as the technical lead in complex B2B sales cycles, alongside account executives and solutions consultants.

• Excellent communicator with business and engineering stakeholders: you anticipate needs, follow through, set clear expectations, and know when guidance beats a custom build, while keeping relationships strong.
• Experience working across CRM and contact centre platforms, and the ability to ramp up quickly on new systems.
• Experience working with AI agents or conversational AI platforms in a customer-facing technical role.
• Hands-on enough with code (Python or JavaScript), cloud services (AWS), and coding agents (Claude Code or Codex) to prototype, review solutions and communicate with engineers.
• Technically curious and resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
• Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, Amazon Connect, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle is a plus.
• Hands-on with MCP or AI agent tooling is a strong plus.
• Shape pre-sales deals with a feasible technical approach, so what’s sold is what our clients can launch.
• Unblock clients when a platform or technology issue threatens a launch, before it becomes an account risk.
• Give Customer Success the technical options that help existing clients raise their automated resolution rate.
• Take bespoke solutions from scope to production with our engineers, with specs they can build against.
• Provide clients and account teams fast, confident technical answers, so deals and launches don’t stall on a technical question.
• Turn repeat solutions into reusable patterns and guides, so every new client moves faster.
• Bring recurring client needs to our Product team as clear, evidence-backed input.
• First 90 days: become the go-to expert on a set of Ada’s integrations, and lead pre-sales and client technical conversations on your own.
At Ada, you’ll not only build extraordinary products but also thrive in an environment designed for your success. We prioritize your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what we offer:
Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health coverage, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance.
Wellness Account: Empowering you to invest in your overall well-being and lifestyle.
Employee & Family Assistance Plan: Resources to support you and your loved ones.
Flexible Work Schedule: Balance your work and personal life.
Remote-First, In-Person Friendly: Options to work from home or at our local hub.
Learning & Development Budget: Invest in your long-term growth goals and skills.
Work from Home Budget: Equipping you with the tools and support for a seamless remote work experience.
Access to Cutting-Edge AI Tools: Work with the best AI tech stack in the industry.
Hands-On with LLMs: Enhance your expertise in leveraging large language models.
A Thriving Industry: Join the forefront of innovation in AI, shaping the future of technology.

The above Benefits and Perks only apply to full-time, permanent employees.
