>Requisition ID: 275115

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

>The Senior Manager – Data Product Manager leads the strategy, lifecycle and value realization of data products and shared data capabilities for International Banking. Reporting to the Director, Data Engineering, the incumbent acts as the senior product authority for the portfolio in scope: defining product vision and outcomes, owning roadmaps and prioritized backlogs, setting measurable success criteria, and aligning business, engineering, architecture, governance, risk and country stakeholders around a common direction. The role translates strategic priorities and customer needs into governed, reusable, domain-aligned data products published on Harbour, the bank's Azure Databricks data platform, following the Harbour target architecture and its producer/consumer model (""engineer once, consume many""). This includes the migration and rationalization of legacy on-premises and Google Cloud Platform workloads onto Harbour. The incumbent also leads a small team of Data Product Managers/Product Owners, establishing product management standards and coaching, developing and directing their work across concurrent initiatives and markets.
column4: >Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

><span>Own and prioritize the product backlogs for the portfolio in scope, balancing business value, regulatory commitments, technical debt and platform capacity
column5: make clear trade-off decisions and communicate the rationale to stakeholders.

column4: >Engage business, Analytics, Risk, Finance, Data Office and country stakeholders to understand data consumer needs, use cases and pain points, and translate them into product requirements, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.
>Define measurable success criteria and KPIs for each data product (adoption, consumer satisfaction, data quality, timeliness/SLA, reuse and cost-to-serve) and track value realization after release.

>Partner with Senior Data Engineers, Architecture and the Harbour Platform team (Data & AI Technology) to shape data products that follow approved Harbour patterns. These patterns include standard ingestion (metadata-driven batch through Azure Data Factory into ADLS Gen2 and, where applicable, change data capture), data contracts, medallion layering (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and a clear producer/consumer separation, so data is engineered once and reused across consumers rather than rebuilt for each use case.

>Lead product-level planning for the migration and rationalization of legacy workloads (on-premises platforms such as DB2, SQL Server, Hadoop and SAS, and existing Google Cloud Platform estates) onto Harbour. This includes source inventory, value and risk classification, prioritization of operational (mirrored) sources as the preferred source of truth, historical load strategy, decommissioning of temporary legacy analytical assets, consumer transition, and sequencing aligned with country workspace onboarding.

>Embed governance by design into every data product, in partnership with the Data Office, Risk and Compliance: clear data ownership, domain catalogs within the centralized Unity Catalog governance model, metadata and semantic definitions, lineage, data quality monitoring, data classification, and role-based access controls that support both country-specific and approved regional (e.g., AML) consumption through country-segregated workspaces.

>Ensure data products comply with enterprise security, privacy, data residency and local regulatory requirements across International Banking markets, including the country-specific regulatory approvals and attestations required to use Harbour. column2: >Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

>We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
>We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

>We are looking for a versatile corporate and regulatory lawyer to join Cohere’s Legal team. Reporting to our Senior Governance Counsel, this role will support a global portfolio of corporate governance, entity and intercompany matters, together with cross-border regulatory, trade and compliance workstreams.

>This role is designed for a lawyer with a strong corporate foundation who has also developed meaningful regulatory and trade experience. You should be comfortable moving between different types of legal work including:
>supporting global corporate governance and entity matters, including subsidiary governance, entity establishment and restructuring, intercompany arrangements and delegated authorities
>supporting cross-border regulatory workstreams, including foreign investment and national-security reviews, regulatory diligence and filing coordination
>helping the business navigate export-control, sanctions and related compliance requirements

>supporting legal and regulatory issues arising from public-sector and regulated-market opportunities, particularly where sovereignty, procurement, security or other market-access requirements come into play.

>You will work closely with colleagues across Legal, Finance, Tax, People, Security, Government Affairs and commercial teams, as well as with specialist external counsel in multiple jurisdictions. The role requires sound judgment, curiosity and the ability to take ownership of a workstream, identify when specialist advice is needed, and turn that advice into practical action.

>Support Cohere’s global corporate governance and entity matters, including subsidiary governance, entity establishment and restructuring, board and shareholder matters, corporate approvals, delegated authorities, signing frameworks and ongoing entity maintenance.

>Support Cohere’s intercompany legal architecture, including intercompany agreements and other cross-border operating arrangements, working closely with Finance, Tax, People and local counsel to ensure Cohere’s entities are structured and operated appropriately across jurisdictions.

>Support cross-border regulatory workstreams, including foreign investment screening, national-security reviews, regulatory diligence, filing coordination and the implementation of regulatory commitments arising in connection with acquisitions, investments, restructurings and other significant matters.

>Support Cohere’s export-control, sanctions and related compliance matters, including coordinating specialist external advice and translating regulatory requirements into practical internal guidance, controls and documentation.

>Support legal and regulatory workstreams arising from public-sector and regulated-market opportunities, particularly where sovereignty, procurement, security or other market-access requirements need to be understood and operationalised.
>Coordinate internal stakeholders and external counsel across jurisdictions, ensuring that legal and regulatory workstreams are appropriately scoped, progressed and implemented.
>Take ownership of matters within the role’s remit and help develop practical, scalable approaches as Cohere’s international footprint grows.
>A qualified lawyer with approximately 4–8 years of relevant experience, gained at a leading law firm, a sophisticated in-house legal team, or preferably a combination of both.

>A strong corporate and cross-border legal foundation, with experience across areas such as subsidiary governance, entity structuring and reorganisations, intercompany arrangements, delegated authorities, corporate approvals and other aspects of international corporate practice.

>Meaningful exposure to cross-border regulatory matters, particularly foreign investment screening, national-security reviews, export controls, sanctions, international trade or related corporate compliance issues. Deep specialism in any one of these areas is not required.

>Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, including coordinating local and specialist external counsel and bringing different legal, regulatory and business inputs together into a coherent internal position.

>Strong judgment, range and commercial awareness, with the ability to get quickly up to speed on unfamiliar issues, identify what matters most and distinguish issues that can be handled internally from those requiring specialist advice.

>The ability to take ownership of an internal legal workstream, ask the right questions of specialist counsel, digest complex advice and translate it into clear, practical next steps for the business.
>Clear and practical communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Tax, People, Security, Government Affairs and commercial teams.
>A collaborative and pragmatic approach, with comfort moving between different subject areas and working across functions, jurisdictions and time zones.
>Experience in technology, AI or another regulated industry would be helpful, but is not essential.
>Exposure to public-sector, government-facing or regulated-market matters is a plus but is not a prerequisite.
>Experience in technology, AI, cloud or infrastructure, or another regulated industry.
>Experience supporting a multinational organisation with a growing international entity footprint, particularly where legal, tax, finance and operational considerations intersect.
>Exposure to public-sector, government-facing or regulated-market matters, including procurement, digital sovereignty, security, accreditation or related market-access requirements.
>Familiarity with North American, UK or EU regulatory frameworks relevant to cross-border technology businesses.
>You can move comfortably between corporate and regulatory matters, identify the core issue quickly and make progress even where the work does not fit neatly into a single legal category.
>You can take ownership of a complex cross-border workstream, bring together the right internal stakeholders and external advisers, and drive it through to a practical outcome.
>You know when specialist advice is needed, can frame the right questions for external counsel, and can turn complex advice into clear, actionable guidance for the business.

>You become a trusted execution partner across Cohere’s corporate governance and regulatory portfolio, taking meaningful ownership of workstreams and creating capacity for more strategic, cross-functional and government-facing work at the senior level.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

The Marketing and Client Solutions Decision Sciences ( Growth) team is at the center of our Media practice, strategy and innovation at CIBC. Its sole focus is to efficiently drive growth in reach and conversions through efficient media investments that are data driven. We work across different enterprise teams at CIBC and Simplii helping them understand and serve our clients and Canadians better each day. We apply best practices in marketing measurement, descriptive and predictive analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence and leverage the latest in big data technology platforms.

Reporting into the COE Lead for Marketing and Client solutions within AI Data and Analytics, this role is responsible for leading a Media decision sciences practice, delivering on strategic priorities, managing and maintaining team operations and senior stakeholder relationships, equipping the Media Ops teams with high quality and timely data and insights to continuously optimize our Media. This Director will lead, manage and mentor a small team of Junior and Media scientists. This role requires a hands-on approach to solving problems, planning and managing change related to all aspects of marketing sciences delivery.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You\'ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you\'ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

Champion media analytics as a strategic growth driver — Serve as the trusted analytics partner to marketing, retail, wealth, and distribution leaders by translating business priorities into clear media measurement, experimentation, and optimization strategies. Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.

Lead measurement, experimentation, and optimization across the media ecosystem — Oversee the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of analytics frameworks, models, and test-and-learn programs that improve media effectiveness. Guide the team in applying advanced analytics, AI/ML, and emerging GenAI capabilities to both structured and unstructured data, with a strong focus on campaign performance, attribution, audience insights, and investment optimization.

Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions — Lead work from problem definition and methodology through execution, validation, monitoring, and refinement. Continuously evolve approaches as business needs shift, new channels emerge, or performance insights suggest optimization opportunities.

Build a high-performing analytics function — Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of media analytics professionals. Hire and nurture talent with the right blend of analytical rigor, business acumen, and media expertise. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and ensure the team is aligned to business priorities and enterprise goals.

Embed responsible, effective analytics practices — Foster high standards in measurement design, data quality, experimentation discipline, and responsible AI use. Ensure the team’s work adheres to relevant policies, governance standards, and best practices while maintaining credibility with partners across the organization.

You are a media analytics leader first. You bring strong command of the media landscape and understand how to connect channels, audiences, and investments to measurable business outcomes. You are fluent in media effectiveness, incrementality, attribution, testing, and optimization.

You combine craft expertise with strategic thinking. You know how to move from business question to analytical approach to actionable recommendation. You are comfortable shaping measurement strategies that inform planning, improve performance, and support better investment decisions.

You are highly analytical and experimentally minded. You have deep experience applying advanced analytics to marketing and media use cases, including forecasting, audience analysis, causal measurement, optimization, and performance diagnostics. You understand how to structure rigorous experiments and use evidence to guide decisions.

You are digitally and technically fluent. You are comfortable working with modern analytics and data science tools such as Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, and cloud-based data environments. You can partner effectively with technical teams while staying focused on business relevance and usability.

You are an effective translator between technical and business teams. You can turn complex analytical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders. You know how to influence decisions, build trust, and bring partners along in environments with complexity and ambiguity.

You are a strong people leader. You lead with clarity, accountability, and empathy. You develop talent, elevate team capability, and create an inclusive environment where high performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

You understand applied AI in a marketing context.— You have experience using traditional AI/ML techniques and an appreciation for where GenAI can enhance workflows, insight generation, and decision support. You are thoughtful about where these tools add value and where rigor in measurement must remain paramount.

You bring strong business and industry judgment. Experience in marketing, media, or sales analytics is essential, and financial services experience is a strong asset. You understand how to operate in a regulated, complex environment while still driving innovation and impact.

You are well-credentialed and credible. You bring advanced academic training in analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, along with a track record of delivering large, high-impact analytical initiatives.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

1. Develop and maintain a central repository of key financial, client and business metrics
• Leveraging source systems and databases for direct data/information extracts
• Gathering information through interviewing, questionnaires, source documents, liaising with other departments and key stakeholders

• Ensuring the analysis is clear, logical, accurate and properly documented

• Developing and maintaining distribution procedures of payment information and supporting data

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Business Analyst to support the BMO Global Asset Management (BMO GAM) business as part of the Investment Solutions and Delivery team.

In this role, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of data-centric investment solutions, from requirements gathering and documentation through data analysis, testing, and final implementation, ensuring solutions enable accurate, timely, and fact-based investment and business decisions.

You will partner closely with Investment teams, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, Data Platform teams, external service providers and other business areas to translate business objectives into clear, testable data and solution requirements.
You will help ensure that delivered solutions satisfy approved business outcomes, data requirements, control expectations, and acceptance criteria.

You will also contribute to the strategy and roadmap for investment data quality, data modeling, reporting, and analytics, including clear documentation of data definitions, data lineage, and business processes across the investment data lifecycle.

• Leads requirements gathering sessions with Portfolio and/or Product Managers, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand business objectives, pain points, and data needs.
• Translates business objectives into clear business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for investment solutions.
• Documents current- and future-state business processes, data flows, control points, dependencies, and operational procedures, and keeps them up to date.
• Maintain end-to-end traceability from approved business outcomes and requirements through data rules, solution design, test cases, defects, implementation evidence, and final business acceptance.
• Assess proposed solutions against the underlying business objective and challenge approaches that do not adequately satisfy approved requirements.
• Serves as a subject-matter expert on investment data, including securities, holdings, transactions, performance, benchmarks, reference data, and related investment datasets.
• Develops and maintains source-to-target data mappings, data dictionaries, business rules, transformation requirements, and supporting data documentation.
• Documents end-to-end data lineage from external and internal sources through to downstream reporting and analytics, supporting data governance, controls, and auditability.

• Perform root-cause analysis of data discrepancies, process breaks, and control issues, working across business, operational, technical and vendor interests to determine underlying causes and appropriate remediation.

• Analyzes, profiles, and reconciles data from multiple sources using SQL and Python to identify gaps, data quality issues, and root causes, enabling more efficient processes and streamlined reporting.
• Structures data into multiple dimensions and granularities (e.g. products, positions, transactions) to support reporting and analytics.
• Rationalizes legacy data sources, ensuring clear stewardship, proper documentation, reduction of technical debt, and alignment with modern data architecture principles.
• Plans and coordinates user acceptance testing (UAT), including test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, and test data, and obtains business sign-off prior to production release.
• Validates data outputs against requirements and source systems and automates validation tests where possible to improve quality and efficiency.
• Logs, tracks, and manages defects through to resolution in partnership with technology teams and vendors.
• Assess proposed defect resolutions and workarounds for their impact on business requirements, data quality, operational processes, control, and downstream consumers.
• Maintain clear traceability between requirements, testing evidence, identified defect, remediation, and business acceptance.
• Supports the design, development, and implementation of data, analytics, and reporting solutions aligned with business strategy and stakeholder needs.
• Coordinates release readiness, production deployment, and post-implementation validation to ensure solutions are delivered as intended, on time and within scope.
• Conducts pre- and post-implementation analyses to measure business impact, and monitors solution performance from an end-to-end perspective.
• Designs reports, dashboards, and visualizations in Power BI and other visualization tools, and develops training materials and user guides to enable self-serve analytics for business users.

• Serves as the trusted data partner and liaison between Investment teams, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, Data Platform teams and other business areas ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
• Work with external stakeholders, including custodians, fund administrators, market data vendors, and technology providers, on data requirements, issues, and changes.
• Challenge external provider requirements, mappings, solution assumptions, proposed workarounds, test evidence, and delivery outcomes where these do not adequately satisfy business requirements.
• Communicates progress, risks, issues, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
• Works independently, exercising judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems and to handle non-routine situations.
• Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

• Typically 7–10 years of relevant experience in business or data analysis, preferably within asset management, investment management, or financial services, and a post-secondary degree in a related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Strong knowledge of investment data and asset management operations, including securities, holdings, transactions, performance, and benchmark data across asset classes.
• Proven experience gathering requirements and producing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, source-to-target data mappings, and lineage documentation.
• Hands-on experience planning and executing UAT and data validation and supporting solutions through to production delivery.
• Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated ability to independently query, profile, reconcile, and validating large and complex datasets.
• Working knowledge of Python (e.g. pandas) for data analysis, automation, and test validation.
• Hands-on experience with Power BI and other data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Spotfire) to build reports and dashboards.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Are you a curious and open-minded individual with an interest in conducting state-of-theart foundational machine learning research? Thomson Reuters Labs is seeking Research Scientists with a passion for building complex agent-based AI systems in a data-rich, complex academic environment driven by real-world problems.

Foundational Research is the dedicated core Machine Learning research division of Thomson Reuters. We are focused on research and development, with a particular focus on advanced algorithms and training techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs). We are building a strong foundation of research capabilities across different areas and are looking for scientists who participate in designing, coding, conducting experiments, translating findings into concrete deliverables and engaging with the academic community. Our focus areas are:
• LLM Training (Continued Pretraining, Instruction Tuning, Reinforcement Learning Alignment, Distributed Training, Efficient ML techniques)
• Post-training techniques for planning, reasoning & complex workflows (e.g., Reasoning Models, LLMs + Knowledge Graphs, Test time compute, CoT pipelines, Tool use & API calling, etc.)
• Data-centric Machine Learning (Synthetic Data, Curriculum Learning, Learned datamixtures, etc.)
• Evaluation (Benchmarks, Human-in-the-loop, red teaming/Adversarial Testing, Hallucination detection, ...)

We work collaboratively both with TR Labs (TR’s applied research division), academic partners at world-leading research institutions and subject matter experts with decades of experience. We experiment, prototype, test, and deliver ideas in the pursuit of smarter and more valuable models trained on an unprecedented wealth of data and powered by stateof-the-art technical infrastructure. Through our unique institutional experience, we have access to an unprecedented number of subject matter experts involved in data collection, testing and evaluation of trained models.

As a Research Scientist, you will play a key part in a diverse global team of experts. We hire world-leading specialists in ML/NLP/GenAI, as well as Engineering, to drive the company’s leading internal AI model development. You will have the opportunity to publish your research findings as well as contribute to our proprietary AI model research & development. Thomson Reuters Labs is known for consistently delivering successful data- driven ML solutions in pursuit of academic excellence and support of high-growth products that serve Thomson Reuters customers in new and exciting ways.

About the role
In this opportunity, as a Research Scientist you will:

• Innovate: You will innovate and create new state-of-the-art Agent AI/LLM Agent approaches at the cutting edge of AI research. You will contribute ideas and work on solving real-world challenges using a wealth of data in agentic contexts.

• Experiment and Develop: You are involved in the entire research & model development lifecycle, brainstorming, coding, testing, and delivering high-quality reports at leading international academic conferences.
• Collaborate: Working on a collaborative global team of research engineers both within Thomson Reuters and our academic patterns at world-leading universities.

• Communicate: Actively engage in sharing our technical findings with the wider community through contributions to seminars, lectures, conferences and/or the sharing of publications and/or technical assets (data & models).

About you
You\'re a fit for the role if your background includes:

Required qualifications:
• Completed or in the process of obtaining PhD in a relevant discipline.
• First-author publications in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, ICLR) with specific focus on agent systems, tool use, or multi-agent coordination
• Familiarity with one or more deep learning frameworks (e.g. pytorch, jax, tensorflow, …)
• Excellent communication skills to report and present research findings and developments clearly, both orally and in writing.
• Curious and innovative disposition capable of devising novel, well-founded algorithmic solutions to relevant problems.
• Self-driven attitude and ability of working with limited supervision.
• Comfortable in working in fast-paced, agile environments, managing uncertainty and ambiguity
• High-impact publications in top-tier conferences or other influence in the research community.
• Experience in ML Research beyond completing a PhD (e.g. supervision, industry experience, leading academic initiatives, …).
• Extensive experience with deep learning frameworks and large-scale model training.
• Extensive experience working on agent-based systems, tool-using AI, or multi-agent coordination in LLM contexts (e.g. startup, industry, or extensive open-source experience).
• Strong software and/or infrastructure engineering skills and ensuring well-managed software delivery, as evidenced by code contributions to popular open-source libraries or writing production code.
• Experience training large-scale models over distributed nodes with cloud tools and providers such as Amazon AWS, MS Azure, LambdaLabs or Google Cloud.
• Learning and development: On-the-job coaching and learning as well as the opportunity to work with cutting-edge methods and technologies.

• Plenty of data, compute, and high-impact problems: Our scientists and engineers get to explore large datasets and discover new capabilities and insights. Thomson Reuters is best known for the globally respected Reuters News agency, but our company is also the leading source of information for legal, corporate, and tax & accounting professionals. In this opportunity as Director, GTM Operations - Europe, you will:

• Excel in directing a high-performing global team, using exceptional interpersonal skills and cultural sensitivity to build a collaborative environment that empowers and drives success across markets.

• Initiate and drive major projects involving data collection, analysis, and investigation, develop recommendations, advocate initiatives, and create a model for implementation.  The extent and range of projects include areas such as territory utilization projects, sales rep analysis, pipeline analytics, territory profiling, forecasting analytics and documenting best practice sales processes

This includes applying conflict resolution and consensus-building skills to drive sales process improvements and enablement initiatives

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Business Analyst to support the BMO Global Asset Management (BMO GAM) business as part of the Investment Solutions and Delivery team.

In this role, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of data-centric investment solutions, from requirements gathering and documentation through data analysis, testing, and final implementation, ensuring solutions enable accurate, timely, and fact-based investment and business decisions.

You will partner closely with Investment teams, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, Data Platform teams, external service providers and other business areas to translate business objectives into clear, testable data and solution requirements.
You will help ensure that delivered solutions satisfy approved business outcomes, data requirements, control expectations, and acceptance criteria.

You will also contribute to the strategy and roadmap for investment data quality, data modeling, reporting, and analytics, including clear documentation of data definitions, data lineage, and business processes across the investment data lifecycle.

• Leads requirements gathering sessions with Portfolio and/or Product Managers, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand business objectives, pain points, and data needs.
• Translates business objectives into clear business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for investment solutions.
• Documents current- and future-state business processes, data flows, control points, dependencies, and operational procedures, and keeps them up to date.
• Maintain end-to-end traceability from approved business outcomes and requirements through data rules, solution design, test cases, defects, implementation evidence, and final business acceptance.
• Assess proposed solutions against the underlying business objective and challenge approaches that do not adequately satisfy approved requirements.
• Serves as a subject-matter expert on investment data, including securities, holdings, transactions, performance, benchmarks, reference data, and related investment datasets.
• Develops and maintains source-to-target data mappings, data dictionaries, business rules, transformation requirements, and supporting data documentation.
• Documents end-to-end data lineage from external and internal sources through to downstream reporting and analytics, supporting data governance, controls, and auditability.

• Perform root-cause analysis of data discrepancies, process breaks, and control issues, working across business, operational, technical and vendor interests to determine underlying causes and appropriate remediation.

• Analyzes, profiles, and reconciles data from multiple sources using SQL and Python to identify gaps, data quality issues, and root causes, enabling more efficient processes and streamlined reporting.
• Structures data into multiple dimensions and granularities (e.g. products, positions, transactions) to support reporting and analytics.
• Rationalizes legacy data sources, ensuring clear stewardship, proper documentation, reduction of technical debt, and alignment with modern data architecture principles.
• Plans and coordinates user acceptance testing (UAT), including test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, and test data, and obtains business sign-off prior to production release.
• Validates data outputs against requirements and source systems and automates validation tests where possible to improve quality and efficiency.
• Logs, tracks, and manages defects through to resolution in partnership with technology teams and vendors.
• Assess proposed defect resolutions and workarounds for their impact on business requirements, data quality, operational processes, control, and downstream consumers.
• Maintain clear traceability between requirements, testing evidence, identified defect, remediation, and business acceptance.
• Supports the design, development, and implementation of data, analytics, and reporting solutions aligned with business strategy and stakeholder needs.
• Coordinates release readiness, production deployment, and post-implementation validation to ensure solutions are delivered as intended, on time and within scope.
• Conducts pre- and post-implementation analyses to measure business impact, and monitors solution performance from an end-to-end perspective.
• Designs reports, dashboards, and visualizations in Power BI and other visualization tools, and develops training materials and user guides to enable self-serve analytics for business users.

• Serves as the trusted data partner and liaison between Investment teams, Investment Operations, Risk, Compliance, Institutional Sales, Technology, Data Platform teams and other business areas ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
• Work with external stakeholders, including custodians, fund administrators, market data vendors, and technology providers, on data requirements, issues, and changes.
• Challenge external provider requirements, mappings, solution assumptions, proposed workarounds, test evidence, and delivery outcomes where these do not adequately satisfy business requirements.
• Communicates progress, risks, issues, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
• Works independently, exercising judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems and to handle non-routine situations.
• Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

• Typically 7–10 years of relevant experience in business or data analysis, preferably within asset management, investment management, or financial services, and a post-secondary degree in a related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Strong knowledge of investment data and asset management operations, including securities, holdings, transactions, performance, and benchmark data across asset classes.
• Proven experience gathering requirements and producing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, source-to-target data mappings, and lineage documentation.
• Hands-on experience planning and executing UAT and data validation and supporting solutions through to production delivery.
• Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated ability to independently query, profile, reconcile, and validating large and complex datasets.
• Working knowledge of Python (e.g. pandas) for data analysis, automation, and test validation.
• Hands-on experience with Power BI and other data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Spotfire) to build reports and dashboards.

• Review performance data and methodology to ensure results are accurate, reproducible, and supported by rigorous analysis.
• Drive investigations of performance regressions and opportunities, partnering across hardware and software teams to identify root causes and potential solutions.

• Translate complex performance results into clear conclusions and recommendations that influence product development, software optimization, competitive analysis, and future performance requirements.
• Coach and develop engineers while evolving Performance Engineering capabilities across Consumer, Enterprise, Physical AI, Robotics, and other emerging platforms and workloads.

• Experience with performance analysis, benchmarking, workload characterization, or system-level debugging.
• Strong technical judgment with the ability to guide investigations, evaluate methodology, and draw sound conclusions from complex or incomplete data.
• Familiarity with scripting or software development for automation, data analysis, or engineering tools.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across organizations, geographic locations, and time zones, and communicate complex technical findings to engineering teams, business partners, and senior leaders.

• Hands-on performance engineering experience with the ability to mentor engineers through benchmarking, analysis, debugging, automation, and performance investigations.

• Experience developing benchmark methodologies, performance automation, or large-scale performance data and analysis pipelines.

• World-class communication skills with a demonstrated ability to articulate a value proposition to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience scaling or optimizing large-scale AI models.

Then come and apply your skills and passion for technology at Thomson Reuters TR labs/AI Platform . You will work with a team driving innovation throughout the entire software lifecycle – from defining specifications and architecting designs to writing efficient, maintainable code. It’s your chance to contribute to TR software that legal professionals use across the globe.

What does TR Labs/AI Platform do? 
We experiment, we build, we deliver. We obsess over our customers through applied research and development of new products and technologies. In TR Labs/AI Platform, we act fast and learn fast, innovating collaboratively across our core segments in Legal, Tax & Accounting, Government, and Reuters News. We compete vigorously with a wide range of projects today, while investing in long-term research for the future. Come prepared to challenge your thinking and contribute back by challenging your colleagues!
 
As a Research Engineering Intern, you will be part of a diverse and interdisciplinary global team of experts. You will work with AI practitioners in Machine Learning, Information Retrieval, and Natural Language Processing, as well as Engineering and User Experience Design specialists to drive the company’s digital and AI transformation. TR Labs/AI Platform is renowned for consistently delivering successful data-driven AI solutions in support of high-growth products for case law, practical law, and fraud detection.

As a Research Engineering Intern:

• Develop and Delivery – You will apply modern software development practices to building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions. You will be involved in the entire software development lifecycle.

• Build Scalable ML Solutions – You will create large scale data processing pipelines to help researchers build and train novel machine learning algorithms. You will develop high performing scalable systems in the context of large online delivery environments.
• Collaborate – Working on a collaborative cross-functional team of applied scientists and engineers, you will learn from and partner with colleagues across the globe.
• Innovate – You will have the opportunity to try new approaches and learn new technologies. You will contribute ideas, create Minimum Viable Products, and work on solving real-world challenges.

The internship duration at Thomson Reuters In TR Labs/AI Platform is typically six months with a flexible start date aligned with your availability. Proposed timeframe: March-September 2026 (to be discussed). We offer a flexible hybrid working environment, with in-office attendance 3 days a week.

About You
You are a fit for the Research Engineering Intern role if your background includes:
• Pursuing a Master\'s or Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
• Proficiency in Python and a deep understanding of related software development stacks and ecosystems.
• Ability to write clean, reusable, maintainable and well-tested code.
• Experience with using code collaboration and versioning systems such as GitHub.
• Desire to learn and embrace new and emerging technologies.
• Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and SDLC concepts for application development.
• Understanding of Natural Language Processing, and/or Machine Learning methods including Large Language Models.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (any of AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and a basic understanding of MLOps tools and practices.
• Familiarity working with unstructured datasets and knowledge about tools and techniques for data cleaning and processing.
• Keen interest in real-world applications and impact.
If you are excited about this opportunity, meet most of the above criteria, and are eager to learn, we want to hear from you!

As the founding lead of Agentic Analytics, a new team in our Analytics and Data Insights organization, you\'ll own how Cohere gets answers from its own data: an agentic analytics system that answers business questions over governed data, shows the source, query, and freshness behind every answer, and asks for clarification or declines when the evidence is insufficient.

>Agentic analytics is far from a solved problem, and correctness is the hard part. A query that runs can still answer the wrong question. Agents go wrong when a business term maps to more than one table, when data goes stale, and when the right context never reaches the model. The worst failures are silent and plausible: a join that double-counts, a wrong denominator, missing data read as zero. Getting this right takes governed definitions, context an agent can use, and an evaluation bar that decides what ships.

>You\'ll build on work already in motion: an internal analytics agent in pilot on our BigQuery warehouse, which is fed by tested ingestion pipelines and modeled in dbt. In your first year, you\'ll take it to production for teams across Cohere, one domain at a time, and make it replicable: each new domain stands up with configuration, a fresh evaluation set, and very little new code.

>This is a hands-on  staff engineering role reporting to our Senior Director of Data Analytics. You\'ll write production code and evaluation sets yourself while managing a small founding team that grows as the system proves itself. You may have held the title software engineer, AI engineer, or data scientist

Design the core services and write much of the first version yourself: agent-facing data tools (MCP or equivalent), context retrieval, agent skills for analytics, and the APIs that serve answers. NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is seeking best-in-class ASIC Verification Engineers to verify the design and implementation of the world’s leading inference accelerator. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have crafted a team of outstanding people around the globe. Their mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. In this position, you will help to build the high-performance processor elements that implement programmable compute and graphics functionality.
• As a key member of our ASIC Verification team, you will verify the design and implementation of inference accelerator
• You will be responsible for verification of the ASIC design, architecture, reference models and micro-architecture using advanced verification methodologies
• Understand the design and implementation of your unit, define the verification scope, develop the verification infrastructure and verify the correctness of the design
• Collaborate with architects, designers, and pre and post silicon verification teams to accomplish your tasks
• Implement and optimize automated verification flows to improve productivity and efficiency
• Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in ASIC design verification and incorporate innovative techniques into the verification process
• Bachelors Degree in EE, CS or CE (or equivalent experience) and 8+ years of relevant industry experience
• Background with building block and SoC level testbench utilizing strong debugging and analytical skills
• Experience in verification using random stimulus along with functional coverage, assertion-based verification methodologies and tools
• Expertise in SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM)
• Experience with design and verification tools (VCS, Verdi or equivalent)
• Experience in UPF power verification is a plus
• Experience in netlist and DFT verification is a plus
• Perl/Python and C/C++ programming language experience desirable
• Knowledge of ASIC design flow, from specification to GDS
• Knowledge of applying machine learning to ASIC verification flow

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our teams are rapidly growing. Are you passionate about becoming a part of a best-in-class team supporting the latest in GPU and AI technology? If so, we want to hear from you.

We accelerate BMO’s AI journey by building enterprise-grade, cloud-native capabilities and AI solutions. Our team combines engineering excellence with cutting-edge AI to deliver scalable, secure, and responsible solutions that power business innovation across the bank. We are engineers, AI practitioners, platform builders, thought leaders, multipliers, and coders. Above all, we are a global team of diverse individuals who enjoy working together to create smart, secure, and scalable solutions that make an impact across the enterprise.

The Applied AI Data Ingestion & Integration (DII) team provides end‑to‑end services to help move, prepare, and operationalize data for AI and analytics workloads. As a Senior Manager within the (DII) Team, you will play a key role in enabling BMO\'s AI and advanced analytics capabilities by transforming complex business requirements into scalable data solutions. You will lead the analysis, profiling, integration, quality assessment, and operationalization of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data used across AI, machine learning, and Generative AI applications.

This position involves close collaboration with various technology teams, Cross POD leads, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, AI and Data engineers, and Business stakeholders to push the adoption of Generative AI technologies and agentic flows across enterprise-wide applications and processes, and to develop partnerships with third-party providers for validating and adopting production-grade solutions. Your work will directly support the development of AI-ready datasets, multimodal document ingestion pipelines, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, Building various connectors, resources, and tools for (Model Context Protocol) MCPs.

This role requires deep technical expertise, strong engineering judgement, and the ability to lead through influence. The successful candidate will be expected to own technical outcomes, mentor engineers, manage ambiguity, and drive measurable improvements in platform capability, delivery quality, operational resilience, and business value.
• Deep hands-on technical leadership with enterprise data onboarding, ingestion, and integration initiatives supporting AI, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.

• Lead and partner with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable data requirements, data models, and integration strategies.

• Design and implement reliable, scalable data ingestion and integration pipelines for structured, semi-structured, unstructured data (e.g., databases, files, documents, APIs, events), and multi-modal data, ensuring data is AI ready, governed, secure, and observable.

• Ensure pipelines follow enterprise governance, access control, and security standards, including role-based access and lineage considerations. Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, and optimize cost and throughput.
• Document processes, share knowledge, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and responsible innovation.
• Establish and monitor data quality standards, controls, and metrics to ensure accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency.
• Partner with Data Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Model Risk Management teams to ensure adherence to enterprise data policies, regulatory requirements, and Responsible AI standards.
• Support data lineage, metadata management, data cataloging, and traceability capabilities across ingestion and integration platforms.
• Collaborate with AI and Data Science teams to prepare, validate, and optimize datasets for machine learning, Generative AI, and advanced analytics applications.
• Support multimodal data ingestion initiatives involving documents, images, audio, video, and enterprise knowledge repositories.
• Analyze performance and effectiveness of chunking, indexing, retrieval, and data preparation strategies used in RAG and AI Search solutions.
• Develop production‑grade services and AI capabilities using Python, REST APIS, JSON/XML, vector databases, RAG evaluation and retrieval metrics.
• Develop analytical frameworks and KPIs to measure data platform effectiveness, ingestion performance, quality trends, and business outcomes.
• Evaluate emerging AI and data management technologies and recommend opportunities to improve DII capabilities.
• Lead cross-functional initiatives from discovery through production, partnering with business, technology, architecture, risk, security, and operations teams.

BMO Canada Wealth Digital is accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its customer-facing digital platforms to enhance client experiences, improve operational efficiency, and enable innovative wealth management solutions. We are seeking an experienced AI Delivery Director to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic AI initiatives that support the evolution of our Wealth Management digital capabilities.

This is a senior delivery leadership role requiring the coordination of cross-functional teams across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Business organizations. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the delivery of secure, compliant, and resilient Multi-Agent AI solutions that leverage enterprise AI capabilities, including the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and AI Observability platforms.

The AI Delivery Director will provide end-to-end leadership across the delivery lifecycle, from intake, discovery, and prioritization through implementation, deployment, adoption, and business value realization by adopting and utilizing AI tools in SDLC. Working closely with engineering leaders, product owners, architects, and executive stakeholders, the role will ensure AI-enabled solutions are delivered on schedule, aligned with enterprise standards, and integrated effectively within the broader technology ecosystem.

column2: >Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers.

>Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products.
>Join us on our mission and shape the future!

>We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans: by way of feedback. By labeling, ranking, auditing, prompting, red teaming, and correcting output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech.

>Cohere is looking for Data Annotation Specialists with backgrounds and skills in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, AI model evaluation, or related fields. This role is best suited for candidates who bring strong contextual judgment, cultural and bias sensitivity, and experience applying nuanced guidelines to complex or ambiguous content. Successful candidates will be highly detail-oriented, comfortable evaluating safety risks across different user intents and scenarios, and able to make consistent, well-reasoned decisions with a high degree of independence after onboarding.

>IMPORTANT CONTEXT ON THIS ROLE: In this position, you will be asked to engage with human-generated and model-generated tasks which will sometimes mean intentional exposure to explicit content. Your annotations on these explicit tasks will be used to prevent the Large Language Model from generating unintentional, adversarial, toxic, or unsafe outputs. The types of explicit content you may be exposed to may include but are not limited to those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

>Please Note: This is a part-time, remote, independent contractor position available within Canada or the United States. We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 45 CAD/hour or 40 USD/hour contract rate, depending on your location, consisting of 30/hour base pay plus 15 CAD or 10 USD/hour hazard pay. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). 12 months contract with potential for extension.
>As a Data Annotation Specialist on safety task, you will:

>Evaluate and improve model safety: Label, rank, audit, and refine human- and model-generated text to improve safety, quality, and policy alignment, including content that may be sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing.

>Apply nuanced safety judgment: Assess model outputs against detailed safety guidelines, rubrics, and style standards, making consistent decisions across ambiguous, sensitive, and context-dependent cases.

>Create prompts and safety test cases: Write realistic prompts, user scenarios, and adversarial examples that help evaluate model behavior across safety categories and uncover unsafe, evasive, over-refusing, or policy-inconsistent responses.

>Support quality and calibration: Identify annotation inconsistencies or unclear guidelines, and provide actionable feedback on recurring edge cases, model failures, and opportunities to improve data quality.

>Work with precision and independence: Complete annotation tasks with strong attention to detail, while being comfortable working independently in a globally distributed, asynchronous team environment.
>You may be a good fit if you have:

>1+ years of experience in Content Moderation,Trust and Safety, AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, or a related analytical role, with exposure to quality assurance, red teaming, and/or prompt engineering preferred.
>Experience applying detailed guidelines to complex and sensitive content, with strong contextual and sociocultural judgment and the ability to recognize and manage personal bias.
>Emotional resilience: Comfort working with content that contains unsafe, explicit, and/or toxic content, including content of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

>Excellent command of written English and the ability to clearly justify content evaluations, including why an output is safe, unsafe, high-quality or low-quality. Bonus points if you are fluent in another language!
>Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, with the ability to maintain consistency across high-volume and monotonous tasks.
>Strong execution in a remote environment, including good time management, comfort using new tools, and the ability to work independently in a global, asynchronous team.

>The Candidate Journey:
Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples.
Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more.
Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team!
Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement

>
As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor.

>It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week.

>Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material.
>If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

We are looking for a passionate AI Research Engineer to join our team. You will work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and product engineering—designing, evaluating, and deploying generative AI (GenAI) systems that are both reliable and impactful. This role blends fundamental research, model evaluation, and practical software engineering to push forward the next generation of intelligent applications.
What will your typical day look like?

Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to design AI-driven solutions that meet technical and business requirements.
Research, prototype, and develop generative AI applications by combining non-deterministic LLMs with deterministic software engineering techniques.
Build evaluation frameworks and benchmarks to measure model quality, reliability, and business impact.
Generate regular reports on model accuracy, drift, and performance.
Debug, optimize, and enhance GenAI applications using prompt engineering, reinforcement learning, fine-tuning, and software engineering best practices.
Train and fine-tune large language models using Hugging Face Transformers.
Apply reinforcement learning fine-tuning techniques using Hugging Face TRL (Transformers Reinforcement Learning).
Manage training workflows with experiment tracking tools and distributed training accelerators (DeepSpeed, Accelerate, FSDP).
Run and optimize multi-GPU training and inference, leveraging vLLM for high-throughput, low-latency serving.
Contribute to the design of scalable MLOps/DevOps pipelines for model deployment, monitoring, and continuous training.
Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and responsible AI guidelines when handling training or test datasets.
Stay current with emerging research in LLMs, RLHF/RLAIF, multimodal AI, and generative models

column2: >Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI.

>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers.

>Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products.
>Join us on our mission and shape the future!

>We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans - by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting text output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech.

>
Cohere seeks dynamic and dedicated Data Annotators with exceptional Modern Standard German Writing, Translation, and Data Manipulation skill.

>Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada. We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 30 CAD/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). Remote work within Canada. 12 months contract. Performance incentives included!
>As a Data Annotation Specialist, you will:
>Label and Rank: Accurately label and rank machine learning data with advanced proficiency in German, ensuring data integrity and quality.
>Audit and Correct: Scrutinize and rectify any inaccuracies in language data (may include text, image, JSON, TSV/CSV, Markdown), maintaining the highest standard of data accuracy.
>Reading and Text-Based Tasks: Efficiently complete reading and text-based assignments, with high attention to detail.
>Preference-Based Tasks: Evaluate and complete tasks, assessing which responses in German best conform to project guidelines.
>Recommend Optimizations: Identify and suggest opportunities for improving data quality and model performance in German language tasks.
>Provide Feedback: Collaborate and communicate effectively, providing feedback to cross-functional team members, particularly on German language-related matters.
>Detail-Oriented Execution: Maintain meticulous attention to detail while performing repetitive and precise tasks, particularly when working with language data.
>You may be a good fit if you have:
>Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in German
>Expert reading and writing skills - which you are ready to prove on our written test.
>Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy - you’re the type to proofread all of your emails!
>High tolerance for repetitive and monotonous work.
>Ability to follow complex instructions, navigate ambiguity and work independently.
>Superb sense of urgency and time management.
>Curiosity about technology and a knack for tackling problems in creative ways.

>The Candidate Journey:
Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples.
Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more.
Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team!
Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement

>
As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor.

>It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week.

>Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material.

Build the Future of Banking with Generative AI

At BMO, we're transforming the future of financial services through Generative AI. We're looking for a passionate and innovative Senior GenAI Software Developer to join our growing team and help design, build, scale, and lead intelligent AI-powered solutions that enhance employee and customer experiences across the bank.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, software engineering, cloud technologies, and business transformation. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop next-generation applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and modern cloud-native architectures.
If you're energized by solving complex problems, experimenting with emerging technologies, mentoring others, and delivering measurable business impact through AI, we'd love to hear from you.
As a Senior GenAI Software Developer, you will:
• Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered applications and solutions that address business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
• Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technical experts to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Build and optimize Generative AI workflows using prompt engineering, AI orchestration frameworks, RAG capabilities, and intelligent automation.
• Design and develop reusable AI skills, prompts, agents, and workflows that can be leveraged across multiple business use cases and teams.
• Develop high-quality, secure, and maintainable code while adhering to enterprise engineering standards and best practices.
• Collaborate on solution architecture, system integrations, APIs, microservices, and cloud-based deployments.

• Lead the delivery of complex Generative AI initiatives from concept through implementation, partnering with technology, business, product, and risk stakeholders to drive successful outcomes and measurable business value.
• Provide technical leadership and guidance to developers and project teams through coaching, knowledge sharing, architecture reviews, and the promotion of engineering best practices.
• Mentor and support team members while helping establish reusable AI patterns, development standards, and governance frameworks that accelerate adoption and delivery across the organization.
• Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to identify opportunities for innovation and business value.
• Support continuous improvement through testing, performance optimization, monitoring, debugging, and troubleshooting.
• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from ideation and design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and JIRA Rovo to accelerate delivery and improve developer productivity.
• Contribute to responsible AI practices by ensuring solutions align with security, privacy, governance, and risk management requirements.
• Drive innovation by exploring new use cases and applying Generative AI capabilities to transform the way BMO works.
• Translate user needs into technical specifications by understanding, conceptualizing, and facilitating business and technical requirements.
• Analyze, develop, test, and implement software solutions while documenting all phases of the software development lifecycle.
• Perform preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for applications and supporting systems.
• Ensure code and configurations adhere to security, logging, error handling, performance, and non-functional requirements.
• Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on systems, processes, data, and risk.
• Follow release management standards and version control practices.
• Assist in interpreting and documenting client and business requirements.
• Work independently on a range of complex tasks and challenges.
• Exercise sound judgment to identify, diagnose, and resolve issues effectively.
• Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying BMO's Risk Management Framework and adhering to all applicable policies, standards, laws, and regulatory requirements.
• Broader responsibilities or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

You are a curious technologist who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a passion for AI and emerging technologies. You thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy learning new tools, and are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of banking through Generative AI while influencing technical direction and mentoring others.

• 7+ years of experience in software development, application engineering, AI/ML engineering, or related technical roles, including experience leading complex technology initiatives and mentoring development teams.
• Strong programming and software development experience with modern engineering practices and design patterns.
• Experience leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-scale applications, cloud-native solutions, or AI-powered platforms.
• Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, engineering standards, and development best practices.
• Experience mentoring junior and intermediate developers and fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving business, technology, product, architecture, security, and risk stakeholders.
• Experience establishing reusable development patterns, governance frameworks, and scalable engineering practices that drive consistent delivery and adoption.
• Experience developing AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI frameworks.
• Design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents using AWS AgentCore, enabling scalable automation, business process optimization, and enterprise AI solutions.
• Strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval techniques.
• Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems, tools, and data sources.
• Experience designing, consuming, and integrating RESTful APIs, including working with Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.
• Experience leveraging GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software development and improve code quality.
• Ability to design, build, test, and maintain reusable AI skills, prompts, agents, and workflows.
• Strong understanding of LLM model selection, prompt engineering, grounding techniques, token optimization, performance tuning, evaluation methodologies, and cost optimization strategies.
• Skills required: SQL, Prompt Engineering, and JIRA Rovo.
• Experience with cloud computing environments and cloud-native application development.
• Experience with microservices architecture, APIs, and system integrations.
• Knowledge of software testing methodologies, Quality Assurance practices, and Test Driven Development (TDD).
• Understanding of secure software development practices, Responsible AI principles, governance, and enterprise technology standards.
• Experience working within Agile delivery environments and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) frameworks.
• Technology Business Requirements Definition, Analysis and Mapping
• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.
• Proven ability to influence technical decisions and stakeholder outcomes across multiple teams.
• Curiosity and passion for continuous learning and innovation.
• Ability to work independently while contributing to highly collaborative teams.
• Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar AI platforms.
• Experience developing AI agents, multi-agent systems, or conversational AI solutions.
• Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search technologies.
• Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, model evaluation, and AI observability practices.
• Experience building and deploying enterprise-scale GenAI solutions within regulated industries such as banking or financial services.

At BMO, you'll have the opportunity to work on transformative AI initiatives at enterprise scale, collaborate with talented colleagues across disciplines, and help shape how Generative AI is used responsibly in one of North America's leading financial institutions.
• Work with cutting-edge AI and cloud technologies.

• Lead enterprise-scale AI initiatives with measurable business impact.
• Mentor and develop talented engineers while contributing to technical excellence.
• Solve meaningful business challenges with real-world impact.
• Accelerate your career through continuous learning and innovation.
• Contribute to a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, and bold thinking.
Ready to help redefine banking through Generative AI? Join BMO and build what's next.
